@layer components;

:root { --lightningcss-light: ; --lightningcss-dark: initial; color-scheme: dark; --canvas: #0b0e0c; --surface: #151a17; --elevated: #1b211d; --border-subtle: #ffffff1a; --border-strong: #ffffff2e; --text-primary: #fafafa; --text-secondary: #d4d4d8; --text-muted: #a1a1aa; --action: #c2410c; --action-hover: #9a3412; --focus: #f97316; --destructive: #e11d48; --success: #6ee7b7; --warning: #fcd34d; --error: #fda4af; --info: #7dd3fc; --brand-green: #1a4d2e; --brand-gold: #d4af37; --shadow-surface: 0 20px 48px #0003; --font-sans: var(--font-public-sans),"Public Sans",Inter,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; --font-mono: "SFMono-Regular",Consolas,"Liberation Mono",monospace; --bg-primary: var(--canvas); --bg-secondary: var(--surface); --bg-tertiary: var(--elevated); --bg-main: var(--canvas); --border: var(--border-subtle); --accent: var(--action); --accent-hover: var(--action-hover); }
* { box-sizing: border-box; }
html { background: var(--canvas); min-width: 320px; }

body { background: var(--canvas); min-height: 100vh; color: var(--text-primary); font-family: var(--font-sans); -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; text-rendering: optimizelegibility; margin: 0px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.5; }
button, input, select, textarea { font: inherit; }
button, a { -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
button { color: inherit; }
::selection { background: rgba(194, 65, 12, 0.45); }
:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }
.sr-only { clip: rect(0px, 0px, 0px, 0px); white-space: nowrap; border: 0px; width: 1px; height: 1px; margin: -1px; padding: 0px; position: absolute; overflow: hidden; }

.skip-link { z-index: 100; background: var(--action); min-height: 44px; color: var(--text-primary); border-radius: 12px; padding: 8px 16px; position: fixed; top: 8px; left: 8px; transform: translateY(-160%); }
.skip-link:focus { transform: translateY(0px); }
.app-shell { min-height: 100vh; }
.auth-state { place-items: center; min-height: 100vh; padding: 24px; display: grid; }
.auth-state .state-panel { width: min(100%, 560px); }

.desktop-sidebar { z-index: 30; border-right: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); background: var(--surface); flex-direction: column; width: 240px; padding: 24px 16px 16px; display: flex; position: fixed; inset: 0px auto 0px 0px; }
.brand-block { gap: 16px; display: grid; }
.brand-lockup { border-radius: 12px; align-items: center; gap: 16px; min-height: 44px; display: flex; }
.brand-lockup img { flex: 0 0 auto; width: 44px; height: 44px; }
.brand-lockup strong, .brand-lockup span { display: block; }
.transport-selector { gap: 4px; width: fit-content; max-width: 100%; display: grid; }
.transport-selector > span { color: var(--text-muted); letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; }

.transport-selector select { box-sizing: border-box; border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); background: var(--canvas); width: max-content; inline-size: max-content; min-width: 136px; max-width: 100%; height: 40px; min-height: 40px; color: var(--text-primary); border-radius: 12px; padding: 5px 48px 5px 16px; line-height: 1.2; }
.transport-selector select:hover { border-color: var(--border-strong); }
.brand-lockup strong { color: var(--text-primary); font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.25; }
.brand-lockup span { color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.4; }
.main-nav { gap: 4px; margin-top: 24px; display: grid; }

.nav-link { min-height: 44px; color: var(--text-secondary); border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); border-radius: 12px; align-items: center; gap: 16px; padding: 8px 16px; font-weight: 400; transition: color 0.16s, background-color 0.16s, border-color 0.16s; display: flex; }
.nav-link:hover { border-color: var(--border-strong); background: var(--elevated); color: var(--text-primary); }
.nav-link[aria-current="page"] { color: var(--text-primary); background: rgba(194, 65, 12, 0.13); border-color: rgba(194, 65, 12, 0.42); }
.nav-link[aria-current="page"] svg { color: var(--action); }
.sidebar-footer { border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); gap: 16px; margin-top: auto; padding-top: 16px; display: grid; }
.sidebar-context { color: var(--text-muted); align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 12px; display: flex; }

.logout-link { border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); min-height: 44px; color: var(--text-secondary); border-radius: 12px; justify-content: center; align-items: center; gap: 8px; transition: color 0.16s, background-color 0.16s, border-color 0.16s; display: inline-flex; }
.logout-link:hover { border-color: var(--border-strong); background: var(--elevated); color: var(--text-primary); }

.mobile-topbar { z-index: 35; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); background: var(--surface); justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; height: 64px; padding: 8px 16px; display: none; position: sticky; top: 0px; }
.mobile-topbar .brand-lockup { min-height: 44px; }
.mobile-topbar .brand-lockup img { width: 44px; height: 44px; }
.mobile-topbar .brand-lockup strong { font-size: 14px; }
.mobile-menu-backdrop { z-index: 60; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.64); justify-content: flex-end; display: none; position: fixed; inset: 0px; }
.mobile-menu-backdrop[data-open="true"] { display: flex; }
.mobile-menu { border-left: 1px solid var(--border-strong); background: var(--surface); flex-direction: column; width: min(88vw, 360px); height: 100%; padding: 24px 16px; display: flex; }
.mobile-menu__header { justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 16px; display: flex; }
.mobile-menu > .transport-selector { margin-top: 16px; }
.mobile-menu .main-nav { margin-top: 24px; }
.app-main { isolation: isolate; min-height: 100vh; margin-left: 240px; position: relative; }
.app-main::before { z-index: -1; content: ""; pointer-events: none; background: url("/operational-grid.svg"); height: 448px; position: absolute; inset: 0px 0px auto; }
.page-container { width: min(100%, 1280px); margin: 0px auto; padding: 32px; }
.page-stack { gap: 24px; display: grid; }
.page-header { justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-end; gap: 24px; display: flex; }
.page-header__copy { max-width: 720px; }
.page-header h1 { color: var(--text-primary); letter-spacing: -0.02em; margin: 4px 0px 0px; font-size: 28px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.2; }
.page-header__copy > p:last-child { color: var(--text-secondary); margin: 8px 0px 0px; }
.eyebrow { color: var(--text-muted); letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; margin: 0px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.4; }
.page-header__actions { align-items: center; gap: 16px; display: flex; }
.page-header__meta { color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 12px; }
.surface-card { border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); background: var(--surface); box-shadow: none; border-radius: 16px; padding: 24px; }
.surface-card__header { justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-start; gap: 16px; margin-bottom: 24px; display: flex; }
.surface-card__header h2, .section-heading { color: var(--text-primary); margin: 0px; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.25; }
.surface-card__header p { color: var(--text-muted); margin: 4px 0px 0px; }
.health-anchor { border-color: var(--border-subtle); }
.health-anchor__content { grid-template-columns: 48px minmax(0px, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 16px; display: grid; }
.health-anchor__icon { background: var(--elevated); width: 48px; height: 48px; color: var(--text-muted); border-radius: 12px; place-items: center; display: grid; }
.health-anchor--success { border-color: rgba(110, 231, 183, 0.28); }
.health-anchor--success .health-anchor__icon { color: var(--success); background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.12); }
.health-anchor--error { border-color: rgba(253, 164, 175, 0.28); }
.health-anchor--error .health-anchor__icon { color: var(--error); background: rgba(225, 29, 72, 0.13); }
.health-anchor--unknown { border-color: var(--border-strong); }
.health-anchor h2 { margin: 4px 0px 0px; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; }
.health-anchor p:last-child { color: var(--text-secondary); margin: 8px 0px 0px; }

.ui-button { cursor: pointer; border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); border-radius: 12px; justify-content: center; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 16px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.25; transition: color 0.16s, background-color 0.16s, border-color 0.16s, opacity 0.16s; display: inline-flex; }
.ui-button:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.48; }
.ui-button--primary { background: var(--action); color: var(--text-primary); }
.ui-button--primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--action-hover); }
.ui-button--secondary { border-color: var(--border-subtle); background: var(--surface); color: var(--text-primary); }
.ui-button--secondary:hover:not(:disabled), .ui-button--ghost:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: var(--border-strong); background: var(--elevated); }
.ui-button--ghost { color: var(--text-secondary); background: 0px 0px; }
.ui-button--destructive { color: var(--error); background: rgba(225, 29, 72, 0.15); border-color: rgba(225, 29, 72, 0.44); }
.ui-button--destructive:hover:not(:disabled) { background: rgba(225, 29, 72, 0.24); }
.icon-button { width: 44px; min-width: 44px; padding: 0px; }
.metric-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0px, 1fr)); gap: 16px; display: grid; }
.metric-card { border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); background: var(--surface); border-radius: 16px; min-width: 0px; padding: 24px; }
.metric-card__label { color: var(--text-muted); letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; }
.metric-card__value { color: var(--text-primary); text-overflow: ellipsis; margin-top: 8px; font-size: 28px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.2; display: block; overflow: hidden; }
.metric-card__qualifier { color: var(--text-muted); margin-top: 4px; font-size: 12px; display: block; }
.metric-card--success { border-color: rgba(110, 231, 183, 0.28); }
.metric-card--error { border-color: rgba(253, 164, 175, 0.28); }
.metric-card--unknown { border-color: var(--border-strong); }

.status-badge { border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); min-height: 28px; color: var(--text-secondary); white-space: nowrap; border-radius: 999px; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 4px 8px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; display: inline-flex; }
.status-badge::before { content: ""; background: currentcolor; border-radius: 50%; width: 7px; height: 7px; }
.status-badge--success { color: var(--success); background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.12); border-color: rgba(110, 231, 183, 0.28); }
.status-badge--warning { color: var(--warning); background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.12); border-color: rgba(252, 211, 77, 0.28); }
.status-badge--error { color: var(--error); background: rgba(225, 29, 72, 0.13); border-color: rgba(253, 164, 175, 0.28); }
.status-badge--info { color: var(--info); background: rgba(14, 165, 233, 0.11); border-color: rgba(125, 211, 252, 0.28); }

.state-panel { border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); background: var(--surface); border-radius: 16px; grid-template-columns: 24px minmax(0px, 1fr) auto; align-items: start; gap: 16px; min-height: 104px; padding: 24px; display: grid; }
.state-panel--compact { min-height: auto; padding: 16px; }
.state-panel strong { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; display: block; }
.state-panel p { color: var(--text-secondary); margin: 4px 0px 0px; }
.state-panel--error { color: var(--error); background: rgba(225, 29, 72, 0.08); border-color: rgba(253, 164, 175, 0.32); }
.state-panel--warning { color: var(--warning); background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.07); border-color: rgba(252, 211, 77, 0.28); }
.state-panel--success { color: var(--success); background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.07); border-color: rgba(110, 231, 183, 0.28); }
.state-panel--info, .state-panel--loading { color: var(--info); }
.state-panel--loading > svg { animation: 1s linear 0s infinite normal none running loading-spin; }
.state-panel__action { align-self: center; }
.info-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0px, 1fr)); gap: 24px; display: grid; }
